01
MILANO · 45°28′ N, 9°11′ E
ORIGIN VERIFICATION
Sourced directly from Italian shelves

Our personal buyers in Milan shop directly from licensed supermarket chains (Esselunga, Conad, Coop) and regional Italian distributors, securing genuine European goods with original Italian packaging and lot codes.

02
TRANSIT · MXP ➔ MNL (10,400 KM)
TEMPERATURE-SAFE FREIGHT
Scheduled monthly cargo flights to Manila

Catalog goods and approved Pasabuy custom items are packed in protective thermal wrap and transported via scheduled air cargo from Milan Malpensa directly to our Manila operations hub.

03
MANILA HUB · 14°35′ N, 120°58′ E
SINGLE MASTER INVENTORY
Physical stock inspection & fast doorstep delivery

Every box is opened, checked for Best-Before dates, and registered into our single master inventory. When you order, staff verify the physical lot in Manila before issuing your payment QR.

ORDERING & STOCK
How does your Single Master Inventory work?

K2 staff manage products and stock in one master inventory. Only products assigned to Website and eligible for sale appear in our catalog. Marketplace connectors are not yet live, so staff reconcile those sales manually.

ORDERING & STOCK
How do payments work and why is confirmation not instant?

Pay by GCash or MariBank QR before dispatch. Use your order payment details once the final total is ready. Upload your receipt and reference; staff verify the funds. A receipt alone does not confirm payment.
